svg.title: Queue of connections during a synchronized burst, n200
svg.desc: For each variant, the median over bursts of the number of connections whose CONNECT is sent and not yet answered, and of the share of the burst admitted, against time since the burst began, with the 10th to 90th percentile band across bursts.
svg.text: A synchronized burst of 200 connections: the queue building and draining
Median over bursts; the band is the 10th to 90th percentile across bursts. Time is since the burst began.
The queue is the client's view: CONNECT sent, no answer yet (the broker's authorization and the callout together).
milliseconds since the burst began (the axis ends at 200 ms; 1 of 16 bursts ran longer and are cut off)
